quests.title: A Superstar... In the Aquarium?

dialogue.t: Mm, I still feel like it's missing something...
Columbina? Furina? What are you guys up to?
What a wonderful way to put it! But the "actors" we're looking for... just so happen to be fish!
Animal actors are hardly a rarity these days. We're looking to cast a charismatic little fishie with just the right attitude to shoot some B-roll... It's essential for setting the mood.
But I feel like we've seen every fish in the whole aquarium, and none of them quite fit the bill.
Should we try asking {NICKNAME} and Paimon for help? They have a knack for solving tricky problems.
Paimon's happy you have so much faith in us... but when it comes to casting fish...

dialogue.sit: We could try rounding up some more "candidates"?

dialogue.t: Great idea! You're the ones with aquarium management experience, after all.
So you're saying we should be on the lookout for talent whenever we go swimming? Paimon doesn't see why not!
Then it's settled! I'll fill you in on the attitude we're looking for later.
I guess this makes you "talent scouts"?
You've really picked up the showbiz vocab since you started hanging out with Furina...

quests.description: Furina seems to be admiring the aquarium…
